title: Demystifying Evals for AI Agents
subtitle: Anthropic's playbook for building eval suites — from "what's an eval" to a zero-to-one roadmap for shipping with confidence.

pages.title: The Anatomy of an Eval
pages.desc: Vocabulary first: task, trial, grader, transcript, harness, suite. Meet the three grader families and the split between capability and regression evals.

pages.title: Four Agent Types, One Pattern
pages.desc: How evaluation looks for coding, conversational, research, and computer-use agents — and why pass^k kills a 75% pass-rate agent for reliability work.

pages.title: Zero to One: A Roadmap
pages.desc: The eight-step playbook: collect tasks from failures, design a stable harness, read transcripts, treat suites as living artifacts. Closes with the Swiss-cheese coverage model.

pages.title: All Flashcards · 40 Cards
pages.desc: Forty flip cards covering every concept across the three guides. Filter by guide, shuffle the deck, or flip everything at once.
